note: Everything needed to reproduce the shipped core binary. Nothing here points at a checkout outside this repository: a fresh clone plus Docker is the whole toolchain. `make core` refuses to package an artifact whose sha256 does not match, so this file is the contract between the build and the pak.

source.note: One commit feeds both shipped FreeJ2ME-Plus binaries: this libretro core and the jar in runtime/runtime.lock.json. The pipe protocol between them is unversioned, so they are never built from different revisions.

patch.note: Runs the jar and Java runtime bundled beside the core by absolute path with the runtime's C.UTF-8 locale selected (LOCPATH, LC_ALL), ties the JVM's life to the frontend with PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, exits the forked child when exec fails, fails retro_load_game() when the JVM is not running, and drops the system-directory firmware entry from the .info file. It also sets this build's defaults for a one-stick Nintendo-style handheld: Fire on A (9 on Y), LCD backlight off, 2 MIDI synthesizers, a Pointer Stick option that lets the left stick move the pointer and keeps it up, with L3 tapping, for 3 s after the stick stops or until another button is pressed, and a pointer tip that stays on the canvas. Its Java hunks, which the runtime build applies to the jar, decode the game's path with sun.jnu.encoding instead of the game's text encoding and stop URL-decoding it: in Libretro.java for the path the core sends, in MobilePlatform.java for a .jad beside the jar.

toolchain.note: Public image, pullable anonymously. The digest is what the build uses; a tag can move under you and a moved toolchain changes the binary.

artifact.note: Recorded from clean builds in the digest-pinned image on 2026-10-19 (a FORCE=1 rebuild and a build in a fresh BUILD_DIR agree). CI is the independent verifier; investigate any mismatch rather than overwriting these values.
